Six things holding you back on Google

We crawled all 14 pages of your site. None of these is hard to fix, and none of them is about speed.

  • 1

    Your headline never says carpet or Mesa

    The main heading on your homepage reads “Professional Cleaning Services.” Google and customers both look for “carpet cleaning in Mesa” at the top of the page.

  • 2

    No Google descriptions on any page

    All 14 pages are missing the short summary that shows under your link in Google results, so Google writes its own from whatever it finds.

  • 3

    Only one photo is yours

    Your branded cleaning wand is the only real photo on the homepage. The rest are stock images: a smiling model, showroom sofas, a puppy and a kitten. You have 33 real photos on Google.

  • 4

    61 images Google can’t read

    About 61 images across the site have no description (alt text), so Google can’t tell what they show and screen readers skip them.

  • 5

    A thin homepage

    About 372 words. The pages that outrank you explain each service, the areas they cover and what it costs.

  • 6

    Two pages with no heading

    Your Reviews and Contact pages have no main heading, so they don’t rank for anything on their own.

Website article

How often should you clean carpet in Arizona? Dust is the big one. Fine desert dust settles deep in carpet fibers and acts like sandpaper every time you walk on it. Most homes: every 12 months keeps carpet looking new and protects the warranty. Pets or kids: every 6 months, plus spot treatment as accidents happen. After monsoon season: a deep clean pulls out the grit and moisture tracked in from storms. Book a cleaning with Steam Master at (480) 805-5731.
